portfolio_contract.PURE_D: all date-valid recorded ETF classes have index_fund_flag D; leverage-risk name tokens excluded; mapped-stock reported weight is 80%-120%
portfolio_contract.INDEX_BD: all date-valid recorded ETF classes have flag B or D; leverage-risk name tokens excluded; mapped-stock reported weight is 80%-120%
portfolio_contract.excluded: enhanced E, unflagged classes, name-flagged leverage/inverse/short products

selection_rule: Residualize log PURE_D strength on standardized log market cap, standardized December-2022 dollar volume, and same-SIC2-as-any-issuer. Within each industry status, define HIGH at/above the residual 70th percentile and LOW at/below the 30th percentile; greedily select five nonreused nearest-covariate pairs by squared standardized size/liquidity distance, breaking ties by larger residual gap then PERMCO.
privacy: full scores and licensed identifiers remain on SCC; public config exports 20 historical symbols and design strata only

sources.dsf: raw/crsp_dsf_2022.parquet; price and volume only for PRE liquidity
sources.names: raw/crsp_dsenames_full.parquet; date-valid identity and SIC only
